product_metadata.title: Signature Design by Ashley Yandel Faux Leather Electric Power Lift Recliner for Elderly, Black
features: POWER LIFT RECLINER: Style and functionality merge in this dual motor lift recliner; With the touch of a button, the power lift eases you back for the ultimate lounging experience
PLUSH COMFORT: Designed for comfy support with a high back, thick cushions and faux leather upholstery; Armchair has sturdy corner blocked frame and a metal reinforced seat
BLACK UPHOLSTERY: Black upholstery looks like leather, but is actually thick poly fiber with a feel-good touch; The neutral color looks great with all kinds of living room decor
GENEROUS SIZING: Reclining chair measures 35inches Wide by 40.5inches Deep by 42.5inches Height with a 20inches seat height and 69inches fully reclined length. Seat height: 20.00"
EASY ASSEMBLY: Instructions, hardware and tools included; Fits through doorways 30inches or wider
DIRECT FROM THE MANUFACTURER: Ashley Furniture goes the extra mile to package, protect and deliver your purchase in a timely manner
BUY WITH CONFIDENCE: Designed and manufactured by Ashley Furniture Industries; The trusted source for stylish furniture, lighting, rugs, accessories and mattresses; For every taste and budget
Note : To ensure proper assembly, please follow all steps provided in the installation manual (provided in pdf below)
description: Double your pleasure and your sense of style with this power lift recliner. Dual motor capability gives you the freedom to recline back and elevate your legs independently for more custom comfort positioning. And with the touch of a button, power lift feature gently eases you from the ultimate slumber into a lift-and-tilt position to get you back on your feet, effortlessly. Designer upholstery may look like gently battered leather, but it’s actually a feel-good fabric with warm, cozy appeal. If you need relaxation in a big way, we have an incredible selection of recliners just for you. Style is just as important as comfort when it comes to picking out a modern recliner—that’s why we offer a vast array of designs, fabrics and colors, along with the newest features.
